subject: Software Engineering
moduleTitle: Unit 4 — Cache Memory Principles, Mapping Functions & Coherency Architectures
moduleDescription: Characteristics of memory systems, the memory hierarchy pyramid, principle of locality, Average Memory Access Time (AMAT), cache lines vs blocks, direct mapping, fully associative mapping, K-way set-associative mapping, replacement policies (LRU, FIFO, LFU, Random), write policies (write-through vs write-back, write-allocate), and multi-core cache coherency (MESI protocol).
